en.compatibility.reason.ADULT_MALE_BETTA_CO: Multiple adult male {source} cannot share this tank.
House adult males in separate suitable systems. Do not rely on a larger group or individual temperament.
en.compatibility.reason.ADULT_SPACE_INSUFFI: The adult space requirement for {source} is not met at {target}.
Use a tank that meets adult length, height and usable swimming-space requirements, or choose a suitable species.
en.compatibility.reason.ADULT_SPACE_UNKNOWN: The adult space requirement or available space for {source} at {target} is unverified.
Confirm adult requirements and usable space after substrate and hardscape displacement. Juveniles still require an adult plan.
en.compatibility.reason.BETTA_CONSPECIFIC_C: No multiple-adult-male rule was triggered for {source}, but this same-species group still has unmet review conditions.
Review individuals, sex, space, cover and management. Prepare immediate separation; V0 defaults to one individual.
en.compatibility.reason.BETTA_SEX_OR_STAGE_: Sex or life stage is unknown for {source}; adult male conflict cannot be ruled out.
Confirm the sex and life stage of every individual before approving a same-species combination.
en.compatibility.reason.BOTTOM_SIFTER_FOOD_: Appropriate sinking food for {source} has not been confirmed.
Provide species-appropriate sinking food. Feces and leftovers are not an adequate feeding plan.
en.compatibility.reason.BOTTOM_SIFTER_NEEDS: No appropriate sinking-food plan is present for {source}.
Provide suitable sinking food and observe feeding. Bottom-sifting fish are not feces cleaners.
The modeled soft-sand foraging requirement of {source} is unmet.
Provide a safe, accessible soft-sand foraging area and reassess. Sifting does not remove the need for waste management.
en.compatibility.reason.BOTTOM_SIFTER_SUBST: The foraging substrate for {source} is unverified.
Confirm a safe soft-sand substrate for this bottom-sifting profile.
en.compatibility.reason.COMMUNITY_RANGE_EMP: The whole-community water-parameter intersection is empty; {source} and {target} define conflicting bounds.
Separate incompatible species or remove a conflicting member, then recompute the entire combination. A freshwater label is insufficient.
en.compatibility.reason.COMMUNITY_WATER_TYP: Separate freshwater, brackish and saltwater requirements into suitable systems; do not invent a compromise water type.
en.compatibility.reason.CONTENT_POLICY_UNKN: The V0 purchasing policy for {source} is unknown.
Have the content owner confirm purchasable_v0, planned or reference_only.
en.compatibility.reason.DIRECTIONAL_FIN_NIP: {source} may nip the fins of {target}; source group size is {source_count}. This is a risk, not a guaranteed attack.
Prefer separating the fin-nipping source and long-finned target. Review group size, space and stress; adequate numbers do not guarantee safety.
en.compatibility.reason.GAPE_PREDATION_RISK: The gape of {source} is not smaller than the body cross-section of {target}; size-related predation is possible.
Separate potential prey or use a dedicated nursery. Cover does not guarantee survival; reassess as animals grow.
en.compatibility.reason.INCONSISTENT_SPECIE: The same species ID {source} uses inconsistent profile instances.
Reference one reviewed profile version for all cohorts of the same species.
en.compatibility.reason.INVALID_STOCK_GROUP: {target} has a missing species/group ID, duplicate group ID, or a non-positive count.
Provide a reviewed species, unique group ID and positive integer count, then reassess.
en.compatibility.reason.NO_VALID_STOCK.mess: No valid stock group is available for assessment.
en.compatibility.reason.NO_VALID_STOCK.repa: Add at least one reviewed species cohort; an empty or invalid composition is not an approval.
en.compatibility.reason.PREDATION_PROFILE_U: The ability of {source} to prey on smaller animals is unverified.
Confirm diet and size-related predation capability. Do not infer safety or total loss from fish/shrimp categories.
en.compatibility.reason.PREDATION_SIZE_UNKN: Gape or current body cross-section data for {source} and {target} is missing; swallowing risk is unresolved.
Confirm current-stage gape and body cross-section, and separate potential prey until verified.
en.compatibility.reason.SAME_SPECIES_GROUP_: {source} has {source_count} individuals, below its recommended same-species minimum of {required_count}. Other fish or shrimp do not count.
After reassessing space, filtration and conflicts, add the same species or choose a species with different social requirements.
en.compatibility.reason.SPECIES_GROUP_MIN_U: The same-species group requirement for {source} is unknown.
Verify social and conspecific-isolation requirements instead of substituting other species.
en.compatibility.reason.SPECIES_RANGE_UNKNO: The reviewed {parameter} range for {source} is missing or invalid.
Confirm the complete species range and reassess. Do not treat unknown data as a compatible freshwater default.
en.compatibility.reason.SPECIES_WATER_TYPE_: The water system required by {source} is unverified.
Confirm the species water system; unknown must not default to freshwater.
en.compatibility.reason.TANK_PARAMETER_OUTS: The current tank {parameter} is outside the reviewed range for {source}.
If a whole-community range exists, adjust gradually into its interior. Otherwise separate species; avoid sudden parameter changes.
en.compatibility.reason.TANK_PARAMETER_UNKN: The current tank measurement for {parameter} is missing or invalid.
Measure and record the current value; compatible species ranges do not prove current water conditions are suitable.
en.compatibility.reason.TANK_WATER_TYPE_MIS: {source} requires a different water system from the current tank.
Move the species into a suitable independent water system.
en.compatibility.reason.TANK_WATER_TYPE_UNK: The current tank water system is unknown.
Confirm whether this is a freshwater, brackish or saltwater system.
en.compatibility.reason.V0_CONTENT_NOT_PURC: {source} is planned or reference-only and cannot be purchased in V0. This is content policy, not an ecological incompatibility claim.
Remove it from the V0 purchase list or wait for an approved content version.
en.compatibility.summary.monitor: No modeled conflict found. Quarantine, staged introduction, monitoring and an isolation plan are still required.
en.compatibility.summary.action_required: Review every blocking, risk, unmet-condition and unverified-data reason. Resolve and reassess before introduction.

zh-CN.compatibility.reason.ADULT_MALE_BETTA_CO: 多只同物种成年雄性{source}不能共缸。
为成年雄鱼安排独立且合适的系统，不以增加数量或赌个性代替隔离。
zh-CN.compatibility.reason.ADULT_SPACE_INSUFFI: 换用满足成体长度、高度和可游空间的缸，或选择适合现有缸的物种。
zh-CN.compatibility.reason.ADULT_SPACE_UNKNOWN: {source}在{target}的成体要求或可用空间未核实。
核验成体要求及扣除底床、硬景后的可游空间；幼鱼也需成体规划。
zh-CN.compatibility.reason.BETTA_CONSPECIFIC_C: {source}未触发多成年雄鱼规则，但同类组合仍有待审核条件。
审核个体、性别、空间、遮挡与管理条件并准备立即隔离；V0默认采用单只方案。
zh-CN.compatibility.reason.BETTA_SEX_OR_STAGE_: {source}的性别或生命阶段未知，不能排除同类成年雄鱼冲突。
核实每个个体的性别和生命阶段后，再评估同类组合。
zh-CN.compatibility.reason.BOTTOM_SIFTER_FOOD_: {source}的适口沉底饲料供应未核实。
确认针对该物种的适口沉底饲料，不能依赖粪便或其他鱼的剩食。
zh-CN.compatibility.reason.BOTTOM_SIFTER_NEEDS: 提供适合该物种的沉底饲料并观察摄食；底栖翻砂鱼不是排泄物清洁工。
提供安全可达的软砂觅食区后重评；翻砂不能替代废物处理。
zh-CN.compatibility.reason.BOTTOM_SIFTER_SUBST: 确认该翻砂物种有可供安全觅食的软砂底材。
zh-CN.compatibility.reason.COMMUNITY_RANGE_EMP: 全组合的水参数交集为空；{source}与{target}形成冲突边界。
分缸或移除冲突物种，再对完整组合求交；同属淡水不能代替参数兼容。
zh-CN.compatibility.reason.COMMUNITY_WATER_TYP: 按淡水、汽水、海水要求分开建立系统，不用折中水型解决。
zh-CN.compatibility.reason.DIRECTIONAL_FIN_NIP: {source}可能咬伤{target}的长鳍；来源同种数量为{source_count}。这是风险，不等于必然攻击。
优先分开咬鳍来源与长鳍对象；核验群体、空间和压力，数量达标也不保证安全。
zh-CN.compatibility.reason.GAPE_PREDATION_RISK: {source}的口裂不小于{target}的身体横截面，存在尺寸相关捕食风险。
隔离潜在猎物或使用独立育幼系统；遮挡不保证存活，并需随生长重评。
zh-CN.compatibility.reason.INCONSISTENT_SPECIE: 同一物种ID {source}使用了不一致的配置实例。
同一物种的所有群组引用同一份已核验配置版本。
zh-CN.compatibility.reason.INVALID_STOCK_GROUP: {target}存在物种/群组ID缺失、群组ID重复或非正数量。
补齐已核验物种、唯一群组ID及正整数数量后重新评估。
zh-CN.compatibility.reason.NO_VALID_STOCK.mess: 没有可用于评估的有效生物群组。
zh-CN.compatibility.reason.NO_VALID_STOCK.repa: 添加至少一个已核验生物群组；空组合或无效组合不表示通过。
zh-CN.compatibility.reason.PREDATION_PROFILE_U: {source}捕食较小动物的能力未核实。
核验食性及尺寸相关捕食能力；不从鱼虾分类推断安全或全灭。
zh-CN.compatibility.reason.PREDATION_SIZE_UNKN: {source}与{target}的口裂或当前身体横截面数据缺失，吞食风险待核实。
核验当前生命阶段的口裂和身体横截面；未知前将潜在猎物分开。
zh-CN.compatibility.reason.SAME_SPECIES_GROUP_: {source}同种数量为{source_count}，低于建议的{required_count}；其他鱼虾不能代替。
空间、过滤及冲突重新评估通过后补足同种，或选择群居要求不同的物种。
zh-CN.compatibility.reason.SPECIES_GROUP_MIN_U: {source}的同种群体数量要求未核实。
核验群居、独居及同类隔离要求，不能用其他物种替代。
zh-CN.compatibility.reason.SPECIES_RANGE_UNKNO: 核验完整区间后重评；不能把未知值当作兼容的淡水默认值。
zh-CN.compatibility.reason.SPECIES_WATER_TYPE_: 确认该物种水型，不能将未知默认成淡水。
zh-CN.compatibility.reason.TANK_PARAMETER_OUTS: 当前缸的{parameter}不在{source}的已核验区间内。
若全组合有共同安全区间，渐进调整至其内部；否则分缸，避免参数突变。
zh-CN.compatibility.reason.TANK_PARAMETER_UNKN: 当前缸的{parameter}测量值缺失或无效。
测量并录入当前值；物种区间兼容不代表当前水质合格。
zh-CN.compatibility.reason.TANK_WATER_TYPE_MIS: 将该物种移入匹配水型的独立系统。
zh-CN.compatibility.reason.TANK_WATER_TYPE_UNK: 确认当前为淡水、汽水或海水系统。
zh-CN.compatibility.reason.V0_CONTENT_NOT_PURC: {source}为planned或reference_only，V0不开放购买；这是内容政策，不是生态不兼容断言。
从V0购物清单移除，或等待审核后的内容版本开放。
zh-CN.compatibility.summary.monitor: 未发现已建模的冲突；仍须检疫、分批入缸、持续观察并准备隔离。
zh-CN.compatibility.summary.action_required: 请查看所有阻止、风险、未满足条件及待核实原因，修复后重新评估。
